items.title: 33.3 Common Water Pollutants (pani ke aam pollutants) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.3 (PDF 250-254); the eutrophication and oil drawings are our own.

blocks.text: Microbiological pollution ka matlab hai pani mein harmful (nuqsan-deh) microorganisms (khurdbeeni jaandaar) ka aa jana, jaise bacteria, viruses, protozoa aur parasites. Yeh insanon aur janwaron ki sehat ke liye sakht khatra hain. Yeh pollution aam taur par tab hoti hai jab bina saaf kiya ya theek se saaf na kiya gaya sewage, animal waste (janwaron ka fuzla), hospital ka waste aur kheton se behta pani (runoff) daryaon waghera mein jata hai. Aise pani mein aam pathogens (bimari phailane wale jaraseem) Escherichia coli, Salmonella aur Giardia hain. Pani ke bacteria, viruses aur protozoa hi pani se phailne wali bimariyon (water-borne diseases) ki bari wajah hain, jaise cholera, typhoid, dysentery (pechish) aur hepatitis A.
